intro.text: Taldain's star system, in which a blue-white supergiant holds both the planet and a second star, the Eye of Ridos, in its orbit.

description.text: Taldain is tidally locked at a Lagrange point, so Dayside always faces the supergiant and Darkside the weaker star, which the Particulate Ring hides. It sits in an unstable orbit called Wombear's Saddle, kept from settling into a stable one by the pull of Ridos together with another force whose nature is unknown.
An outside force keeps Taldain's moon in a fixed orbit relative to the planet, and that orbit sets the length of a Taldain day.
The Eye of Ridos is a faint white dwarf ringed by particles. Every seven orbits of the moon Nizh Da it sends pulses of light and Investiture out through the ring, which Invest the Starcarved.
